title: The Ridge Where Echoes Learn to Answer

features.name: the arguing echoes
features.desc-on-touch: Two voices speak the same sentence differently. One closes; one opens. They overlap, debate, refuse each other's endings. You realize they have been doing this since the ridge was formed.

features.name: the oracle-shard
features.desc-on-touch: Scratched stone bearing incomplete text—a divination verse, worn smooth on half the words. Scholars argue whether the missing parts were erased or are waiting to be remembered.

features.name: the branching path-tree
features.desc-on-touch: A split trunk that branches impossibly—each fork holds a different version of the same route. All paths lead here; all lead away. The newest growth still trembles with indecision.

features.name: the empty answer-chamber
features.desc-on-touch: A smooth hollow in the ridge where seven echoes converge. But the eighth voice—the one that should resolve them—never arrived. Its silence is louder than all the arguing.

inscription: the ridge learned that answers can argue with themselves and still be true; echoes taught it that unresolved is not the same as unheard

file.name: Oracular_Text_Recovery_or_Invention_Scholarly_Dispute.txt
file.note: Photocopied pages from competing academic articles about reconstructing a Twelve-Word Oracle. Handwritten marginalia in two different hands argue directly at each other in the spaces between the print

exits.label: the ridge descends toward mist and the parent summit
downward into chambers where arguments grow roots
northward where the ridge sharpens and the echoes grow louder
